pages.text: $(italic)Magic investment. Best for Archmage, Battlemage and Void Summoner.$()$(br2)Spell power, mana pool and mana regen are Iron's Spellbooks attributes and apply immediately, and so do the cast duration reduction and summon damage bonuses. Buff duration extension needs KubeJS (Phase 2).

pages.title: Nodes
pages.text: $(bold)Spell Power$(): the core trunk, through irons_spellbooks:spell_power, and a direct multiplier on all spell damage.$(br2)$(bold)Mana Mastery$(): more max mana and passive regen. It scales the Archmage's Mana Well passive.$(br2)$(bold)Cooldown Reduction$(): shorter spell cooldowns, through irons_spellbooks:cooldown_reduction.

pages.title: Nodes (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Destruction Branch$(): spell penetration and raw damage, best for Archmage.$(br2)$(bold)Arcane Branch$(): mana efficiency and buff duration, best for a support-leaning Battlemage.$(br2)$(bold)Sorcery Capstone$(): $(bold)Arcane Attunement$(). After 10 consecutive spell kills, spells cost 0 mana for 8s, on a 120s cooldown.
